title: 第十二章 出发Z州
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林夕关掉系统的页面走向了离自己不远抱着腿坐在地上的孙悦，看着孙悦发呆的表情说道：“怎么了，想什么呢。”

突然的说话声将发呆的孙悦吓了一跳，急忙站了起来，看向一边，便看到林夕笑嘻嘻的看着自己。

孙悦白了一眼林夕说道：“你怎么走路没声音啊！

林夕笑着说道：”是你想东西想的太专注了好吧！“

孙悦没有说话，往旁边挪了挪，林夕一批过坐了下来。

孙悦开口说道：”林夕，你说，我们还能回到原来的样子吗？“

林夕转过头看了一眼略显失落的孙悦，不忍心的安慰道：”会的，我们一定会回到原来的生活的。“

孙悦听道林夕明显是安慰自己的话语后笑了笑便没有在说话

就在这时林夕突然想到了什么似的随后便向坐在角落里的一个女生坐过去

坐在角落的少女赫然就是刚开始林夕所解救的女生马洁

后面由于好几次的战斗都过于惊险，林夕也没有顾得上这个扎着高马尾的女生

马洁看到走过来的林夕说道:“我前面看你昏倒了，怎么样没事吧？“

林夕笑了笑说道:“没事，怎么样，你是跟我们走吗？”

马洁低下了头犹豫了一会说道：“嗯，我跟你们走。”

林夕笑了笑说道：“我们这一路会很危险，你确定吗？“

马洁说道：”这不是有你在呢吗？”

林夕说道：“我可是很坏的。“

马洁咬了咬嘴唇说道：”我才不怕。“

林夕笑了笑说道：”好，我跟你保证，只要我还活着，你就不会有危险。“

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Xi closed the system page and walked towards Sun Yue, who was sitting on the ground with her legs crossed not far away. She looked at Sun Yue's dazed expression and said, "What's wrong? What are you thinking about?"

The sudden voice startled Sun Yue, who was in a daze, and he stood up hurriedly. Looking to the side, he saw Lin Xi looking at him with a smile.

Sun Yue rolled her eyes at Lin Xi and said, "Why are you walking without making any sound?

Lin Xi smiled and said, "It's because you're thinking too hard, right?""

Sun Yue didn't say anything, but moved to the side, and Lin Xi passed by and sat down.

Sun Yue said: "Lin Xi, tell me, can we go back to the way we were before?"

Lin Xi turned her head and glanced at the slightly disappointed Sun Yue, and couldn't bear to comfort her: "Yes, we will definitely return to our original life."

After hearing Lin Xi's obviously comforting words, Sun Yue smiled and stopped talking.

At this moment, Lin Xi suddenly thought of something and then sat over to a girl sitting in the corner.

The girl sitting in the corner is suddenly the girl Ma Jie whom Lin Xi rescued at the beginning.

Because several subsequent battles were too thrilling, Lin Xi did not pay attention to this girl with a high ponytail.

Ma Jie saw Lin Xi walking over and said, "I saw you fainted from the front, are you okay?"

Lin Xi smiled and said: "It's okay, how about it, are you coming with us?"

Ma Jie lowered her head and hesitated for a while before saying, "Well, I'll go with you."

Lin Xi smiled and said: "Our journey will be very dangerous, are you sure?"

Ma Jie said: "Aren't you here?"

Lin Xi said: "I am very bad."

Ma Jie bit her lip and said, "I'm not afraid."

Lin Xi smiled and said: "Okay, I promise you, as long as I am still alive, you will not be in danger."
